name: Duplicate Fingerprint Reconciliation Fix
changes: Fixes the remaining Smart Import repeat-download loop when a downloaded Automation release is byte-identical to the existing library file and is classified as DUPLICATE.
Carries explicit fingerprint-verification evidence from import planning through staging cleanup so duplicate provenance can be reconciled after the redundant staging file is removed.

When an Automation DUPLICATE is fingerprint-proven, stamps the selected release traits and dynamic-range trust onto the existing library record, binds the release title to the existing fingerprint cache record, and recalculates cutoff from the canonical record used by Wanted.
Preserves trusted release traits and dynamic-range state when KEEP_EXISTING retains an equal or better library file instead of rebuilding that record from the lightweight media probe alone.
Prevents the same byte-identical DV or DV+HDR payload from remaining an unconfirmed legacy target and being selected repeatedly after a successful duplicate reconciliation.

Preserves v3.6.88 confidence-aware dynamic-range handling, v3.6.86 cache-snapshot performance, SABnzbd 5.1.2, Metadata Server v0.3.3, Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31 and frozen Newsgroup Browser behavior.
regression_guards: A fingerprint-identical DV+HDR download reconciles the existing episode as trusted DV+HDR and removes the satisfied target from Wanted after a disk reload.
A fingerprint-identical DV-only corrective replacement remains Wanted for DV+HDR, but the same DV-only release is no longer eligible as another same-rank corrective replacement.
KEEP_EXISTING preserves prior trusted DV/HDR provenance rather than erasing it with an inconclusive lightweight probe.
The duplicate fingerprint proof survives the pre-reconciliation staging cleanup boundary.
v3.6.88 confidence-aware evidence, v3.6.86 snapshot performance and frozen unrelated subsystems remain guarded.
